info.description: Lists the vendors of the partner.
info.title: Android Device Provisioning Partner API

requests.description: Lists the user's customer accounts.
requests.name: GET /v1/customers

requests.description: Updates reseller metadata associated with the device. Android devices only.
requests.name: POST /v1/partners/{metadataOwnerId}/devices/{deviceId}/metadata
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Lists the customers that are enrolled to the reseller identified by the `partnerId` argument. This list includes customers that the reseller created and customers that enrolled themselves using the portal.
requests.name: GET /v1/partners/{partnerId}/customers
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Claims a device for a customer and adds it to zero-touch enrollment. If the device is already claimed by another customer, the call returns an error.
requests.name: POST /v1/partners/{partnerId}/devices:claim
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Claims a batch of devices for a customer asynchronously. Adds the devices to zero-touch enrollment. To learn more, read [Long‑running batch operations](/zero-touch/guides/how-it-works#operations).
requests.name: POST /v1/partners/{partnerId}/devices:claimAsync
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Finds devices by hardware identifiers, such as IMEI.
requests.name: POST /v1/partners/{partnerId}/devices:findByIdentifier
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Finds devices claimed for customers. The results only contain devices registered to the reseller that's identified by the `partnerId` argument. The customer's devices purchased from other resellers don't appear in the results.
requests.name: POST /v1/partners/{partnerId}/devices:findByOwner
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Unclaims a device from a customer and removes it from zero-touch enrollment.
requests.name: POST /v1/partners/{partnerId}/devices:unclaim
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Unclaims a batch of devices for a customer asynchronously. Removes the devices from zero-touch enrollment. To learn more, read [Long‑running batch operations](/zero-touch/guides/how-it-works#operations).
requests.name: POST /v1/partners/{partnerId}/devices:unclaimAsync
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Updates the reseller metadata attached to a batch of devices. This method updates devices asynchronously and returns an `Operation` that can be used to track progress. Read [Long‑running batch operations](/zero-touch/guides/how-it-works#operations). Android Devices only.
requests.name: POST /v1/partners/{partnerId}/devices:updateMetadataAsync
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Deletes an unused configuration. The API call fails if the customer has devices with the configuration applied.
requests.name: DELETE /v1/{name}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Gets a device.
requests.name: GET /v1/{name}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Updates a configuration's field values.
requests.name: PATCH /v1/{name}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Lists a customer's configurations.
requests.name: GET /v1/{parent}/configurations
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Creates a new configuration. Once created, a customer can apply the configuration to devices.
requests.name: POST /v1/{parent}/configurations
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Lists the customers of the vendor.
requests.name: GET /v1/{parent}/customers
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Creates a customer for zero-touch enrollment. After the method returns successfully, admin and owner roles can manage devices and EMM configs by calling API methods or using their zero-touch enrollment portal. The customer receives an email that welcomes them to zero-touch enrollment and explains how to sign into the portal.
requests.name: POST /v1/{parent}/customers
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Lists a customer's devices.
requests.name: GET /v1/{parent}/devices
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Applies a Configuration to the device to register the device for zero-touch enrollment. After applying a configuration to a device, the device automatically provisions itself on first boot, or next factory reset.
requests.name: POST /v1/{parent}/devices:applyConfiguration
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Removes a configuration from device.
requests.name: POST /v1/{parent}/devices:removeConfiguration
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Unclaims a device from a customer and removes it from zero-touch enrollment. After removing a device, a customer must contact their reseller to register the device into zero-touch enrollment again.
requests.name: POST /v1/{parent}/devices:unclaim
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Lists the DPCs (device policy controllers) that support zero-touch enrollment.
requests.name: GET /v1/{parent}/dpcs
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Lists the vendors of the partner.
requests.name: GET /v1/{parent}/vendors
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
